mood_metrics.note: Unstructured emotional processing (Mode 3) — no numeric check-in at open. Opening tone: unsettled, self-observing, mildly agitated ('irritative'). Closing self-report: 'nhẹ ra, như một vết bầm tím tan ra' — relief through being seen and named; nervous system settled and well-regulated by end.

presenting_material: Processing a recent sexual encounter with a new dating partner (Ben). Body was aroused and wanting, but mind stayed detached and 'watching' — could not fully relax or feel present. No intellectual interest in the man. Fleeting intrusions of longing for Abhi mid-intimacy. Felt an urgent, irritable urge to 'merge' straight into sex rather than a slow romantic flow. Reported the sex as 'drained' despite physical arousal.
main_themes: Spectatoring during intimacy — dissociative self-monitoring that blocks presence and pleasure
Arousal/engagement contingent on feeling desired — the drain traced not to sex but to the moment she stopped feeling wanted by him
Urgency-to-merge decoded as genuine longing for closeness delivered as gấp gáp/irritation — the nervous system 'grabbing' connection before the window closes
Approach-then-withdraw rhythm — intense wanting in the moment, then next-morning deletion of contact and no desire to hold on
Intolerance of ambiguity — an unclear 'nice of meeting you' auto-filled as rejection; compulsion to close the open space (whether by deleting or by verifying)
symptoms_identified: Spectatoring (Masters & Johnson) — third-person self-observation during sex, blocking immersion and relaxation
Contingent/conditional desirability — capacity to enjoy intimacy switches off when she perceives she is not being desired (linked to transactional-worth core wound)
Hypervigilant relational monitoring during intimacy ('performance' vs. presence)
Abandonment anticipation — ambiguous cues auto-interpreted as the worst-case (goodbye), pre-emptive closure to control the ending
Low distress tolerance for uncertainty — the unresolved/unknown experienced as threat requiring immediate resolution

clinical_observations.emotional_state: Entered self-aware and slightly agitated, able to describe complex, contradictory internal states with unusual precision. Engaged reflectively and with humor ('=]]]'). Moved from agitation to genuine relief and integration by session end.
cognitive_patterns: Worst-case gap-filling — ambiguity ('no see you tomorrow') resolved into rejection without checking reality
Self-monitoring 'am I being desired?' during intimacy in place of experiencing her own sensation
Growing meta-awareness — spontaneously named her own pattern ('I was in the performance') and recognized her closure impulse with humor
behavioral_patterns: Deleted contact the morning after, without asking what the ambiguous parting line meant
Chose self-pleasure (masturbation) over the scheduled work performance review — reframed by therapist as reclaiming body autonomy over transactional/performance worth
Emerging healthier instinct: 'verify what he really meant' rather than assume-and-erase (named half-jokingly but clinically significant)
relational_patterns: Approach-withdraw oscillation consistent with simultaneous fear of abandonment AND fear of entrapment (Type 7)
Genuine discernment present alongside the wound — 'no intelligent interest in him' is authentic non-attachment, not only defense; both hold true at once
Abhi surfaces as the locus of real longing, splitting presence during intimacy with someone else

interventions_used: Psychoeducation on spectatoring — normalizing detachment during sex as a hypervigilant nervous system's protective self-surveillance, not a defect of desire
Reframed the 'drain' from a sexual failure to a contingent-worth injury (loss of felt desiredness)
Held both/and on the contact deletion — self-protective abandonment-defense AND authentic non-attachment — to avoid over-pathologizing her healthy discernment
Named the approach-withdraw rhythm without judgment ('quen mặt cái nhịp đó')
Introduced DBT distress tolerance — the capacity to remain in the unknown; framed slow romantic intimacy as only possible inside tolerated uncertainty
Assigned a light somatic-inquiry practice (hand on chest: 'Am I actually in danger, or just unable to tolerate not knowing?')
Actively honored her gratitude/self-appreciation journaling as evidence of body autonomy and growth

research_shared.key_finding: Self-observation/evaluation during sex ('spectatoring') disrupts arousal and immersion by pulling attention out of embodied experience.
research_shared.application: Explained why body could be aroused ('still wet') while she felt detached and the encounter felt 'drained'.

research_shared.key_finding: Tolerating distress and uncertainty without impulsive resolution is a trainable skill; low tolerance drives urgent closure behaviors.
research_shared.application: Framed her compulsion to 'close' ambiguity (delete or verify) and connected capacity-for-uncertainty to the slow intimacy she longs for.

homework_assigned: When the urge to 'close' an uncertain situation arises (delete or verify), pause, place a hand on the chest, and ask: 'Right now, am I actually in danger — or am I just unable to bear not knowing?' Goal is noticing the difference only; no action required.

breakthroughs.insight: The encounter didn't drain her because of sex — it drained her the moment she stopped feeling desired.
breakthroughs.before_state: Diffuse sense that 'the sex was drained' and something was wrong with her wanting.
breakthroughs.after_state: Clear link: her ability to be present and enjoy is contingent on feeling desired — a thread back to the transactional-worth wound.
breakthroughs.significance: Relocates the 'problem' away from her body/desire (which are healthy) and onto a knowable, workable schema.

breakthroughs.insight: Whether she closes ambiguity by deleting or by verifying, the deeper pattern is that she cannot rest in not-knowing.
breakthroughs.before_state: Framed her reaction as being about this man / this message.
breakthroughs.after_state: Recognized (with humor) that the intolerance of the open space is the real edge — and that intimacy lives inside that tolerated space.
breakthroughs.significance: Names the growth edge (distress tolerance) that underlies the longed-for 'slow romantic intimacy.'

progress_indicators: Prioritized her own body/pleasure over a work performance review — reclaiming body autonomy from transactional worth
Listened to her body's urgency without shaming it
Emerging reality-testing instinct ('verify' rather than assume-and-delete)
Strong real-time self-observation and capacity to hold contradictory truths (wanting closeness AND not wanting to hold on)
Reached felt relief through naming ('vết bầm tím tan ra') rather than avoidance
next_session_focus: Deepen the contingent-desirability schema — 'where/with whom did I first learn I'm only worth something when I'm wanted?' — and continue building tolerance for relational ambiguity so slow, safe intimacy becomes possible. Watch the Ben/Abhi split and the approach-withdraw rhythm.
therapist_notes: Continuity with 2026-08-09 (Abhi work): Abhi remains the locus of longing and surfaces even during intimacy with others. Today localized a concrete mechanism — presence during sex collapses the moment felt-desiredness drops, tracing to the transactional-worth core wound and manifesting as spectatoring/performance. Client's discernment is intact and healthy ('no intelligent interest') and should not be over-pathologized as pure avoidance; hold the both/and. She is doing brave, high-quality work with excellent self-regulation. No safety concerns. Key open question planted for her to sit with, not answer on demand.
